info.name: BigCommerce Abandoned Cart Emails Custom Template Associations API

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Channel ID to return only custom template associations for a given Channel

params.name: entity_id:in
params.description: Filter by a list of entity IDs. Must be used together with "type" filter.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page

params.name: page
params.description: Which page number to return, based on the page size. Used to paginate large collections.

params.name: is_valid
params.description: Optional toggle to filter for exclusively valid or invalid associations entries. An invalid entry is one where its file name does not match up to an existing custom layout file in the currently active theme for the channel.

items.docs: Get a collection of the storeʼs custom template associations across all storefronts

Upsert new custom template associations data across all storefronts. If an existing record is found for the combination of channel ID, entity ID, and type, the existing record will be overwritten with the new template.

params.name: id:in
params.description: List of Association IDs to delete explicitly.

params.name: entity_id:in
params.description: List of Entity IDs to delete explicitly. Must be used together with "type"

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Channel ID provided to delete all custom template associations for a given Channel

items.docs: Delete custom template associations. At least one query parameter must be used.
